## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.7

### 新变化

- **macOS 版首次带 Apple 签名和公证**：App 用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证（DMG 也已签名）。下载后拖进「应用程序」双击就能打开，不用再按住 Control 点「打开」，也不用在终端运行 `xattr`。
- **启动后静默待在菜单栏**：除了第一次运行显示欢迎页，之后每次启动都安静地待在菜单栏（Windows 上是托盘），不再弹出设置页。想打开设置，点菜单栏图标里的「设置」，或在黑着跑已经运行时再打开一次它。（感谢用户反馈）

### 注意

- **Mac 老用户升级到这一版后，需要重新允许一次权限**：因为签名从临时签名换成了正式签名，macOS 会把它当成新 App。请在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性」里，把「辅助功能」和「输入监控」里的黑着跑重新打开（如果有旧的条目，可以先用「−」删掉再重新添加）。只需要这一次，之后的更新会保留权限。

更新方式：已安装 0.1.1 及以上版本时，在「设置 › 关于与诊断」里点「更新并重启」，或等每日检查自动提示。

---

## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.7

### What's new

- **macOS build is now signed and notarized by Apple**: the app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple (the DMG is signed too). Drag BlankRun to Applications and double-click it — no more Control-click › Open or `xattr` in Terminal.
- **Starts quietly in the menu bar**: apart from the welcome screen on the very first run, BlankRun now always starts in the menu bar (the notification area on Windows) without opening Settings. To open Settings, use the menu bar icon, or open BlankRun again while it's running. (Thanks for the feedback!)

### Notes

- **Mac users upgrading: allow permissions once more.** Because the app moved from an ad-hoc signature to a Developer ID signature, macOS treats it as a new app. In System Settings › Privacy & Security, turn BlankRun on again under Accessibility and Input Monitoring (remove the old entry with "−" and add it again if needed). This is needed only once; later updates keep the permissions.

To update from 0.1.1 or later, click "Update and restart" in Settings › About & Diagnostics, or wait for the daily check.
